q1.rubricZh: 要点：sheep 和 mice 各1分。
q1.explanationZh: 第二段举了巴斯德用羊做实验、耶尼施把病毒 DNA 放进老鼠体内这两个例子，所以是羊和老鼠。

evidence.quote: Louis Pasteur conducted experiments on sheep
Rudolf Jaenisch introduced viral DNA into mice

q2.rubricZh: 要点：超过1.15亿只（more than 115 million）。
q2.explanationZh: 第三段说据说每年有超过1.15亿只动物被用在实验里。

evidence.quote: It is said that more than 115 million animals are used in experiments every year.

q3.sampleAnswer: Lab animals are harmed in many ways and some tests even require the animal to die.

keyPoints.descZh: 实验动物以多种方式受到伤害，有些实验甚至要让动物死亡
examples: Lab animals are harmed in many ways
Some tests even require the animal to die

q3.rubricZh: 要点：动物受到多种伤害，有些实验甚至需要动物死亡。
q3.explanationZh: 第四段说实验室里的动物会受到各种伤害，有的实验还要让动物死去，这就是令人难过的情况。

evidence.quote: Lab animals are harmed in many ways. Some tests even require the animal to die.

q4.sampleAnswer: Using 3D chips made from human cells, testing cells from cancer patients’ tumors, and using computer models.

keyPoints.descZh: 用癌症病人肿瘤中的细胞测试不同疗法
examples: test treatments with cells from a cancer patient’s tumor

q4.rubricZh: 要点：3D 芯片、肿瘤细胞测试、计算机模型，三种方法都要答出。
q4.explanationZh: 第六段列出了三种代替动物实验的方法：用人体细胞做的3D芯片、用癌症病人肿瘤里的细胞试疗法、用电脑模型预测药效。

evidence.quote: Some scientists remove cells from a cancer patient’s tumor.
Researchers also make use of computer models.

q5.sampleAnswer: They help improve the understanding and treatment of the human body, and they are also faster and cheaper than animal testing.

keyPoints.descZh: 有助于改善对人体的了解和治疗
examples: help improve the understanding and treatment of the human body

keyPoints.descZh: 比动物实验更快、更便宜
examples: faster and cheaper than animal testing

q5.rubricZh: 要点：有助于了解和治疗人体；比动物实验更快更便宜。
q5.explanationZh: 第六段最后几句说，这些方法能帮助我们更了解人体、更好地治疗，而且比动物实验又快又便宜。

evidence.quote: These methods help improve the understanding and treatment of the human body.
They are also faster and cheaper than animal testing.

q6.sampleAnswer: I think animal testing is necessary to protect human health, but it is unkind to animals. Animals should be treated with kindness and respect as well. (Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 明确表明对动物实验的态度
examples: I think animal testing is necessary.

keyPoints.descZh: 给出至少一条合理理由
examples: Non-animal methods are faster and cheaper.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可：先表明态度，再给出至少一条合理理由。
q6.explanationZh: 这是观点题，没有唯一答案。先说你支持还是反对动物实验，再讲理由，比如保护人类健康、或者动物也该被善待。

evidence.quote: They believed that animals should not be harmed for humanity’s sake.
